name: Find liblantern-native without DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH, which macOS strips from nox test's shell

comments.text: On Dean's Mac, run-tests.sh passed 138 of 189: the 51 programs that link liblantern-native abort with 'Library not loaded: @rpath/liblantern-native.dylib, no LC_RPATH's found'. nox test builds and runs each program through /bin/sh, and System Integrity Protection drops DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH for it. Fix: give the library its absolute build path as its install name, so every program that links it records where it is.
